durable: preset-v1.json is the receipt the recording installed, credential-owner-v1.json the ledger the credential owner adopted and the workspace preset pinned, artifacts/job-input-hap/ the five unsigned inputs, artifacts/<job>/ART-* the signed HAP and signing report of the signed Job and of the Job recovered by readback, rejected-parked-record.json and verify-once-parked-record.json the durable records of the two Jobs parked on an unknown outcome, before their reconcile
frames: job.plan, job.submit, job.run, job.reconcile and job.result of every workspace.sign-openharmony-hap@1 Job, in the order the control plane answered them
replayedBy: the Rust port of workspace.sign-openharmony-hap@1 (TASK-XPA-015, M3)
secrets: the recording asserts neither fake password appears in any file below its root; no Keychain item, real credential or real signer is involved
source: the production RuntimeControlPlaneHandler over a RuntimeJobEngine whose only provider is WorkspaceOperationsProvider with a registered signing preset resolved through OpenHarmonySigningCredentialOwner, and OpenHarmonySigningWorkspaceDispatcher over OpenHarmonySigningPresetStore, over a fixed root /private/tmp/arkdeck-workspace-sign-oracle
